reviewNotes.zh: 依据官方署名文字稿重写线索；同场干扰选项按具体段落排除。2020 未取得可核验官方署名正文，未选入。只核验发布会上的介绍或演示，不声称功能已交付。原研究包的原声题仍未启用。2026-09-23 并入 one_more_tune_improvement_20260922 的 15 道人物题（2016–2019 五场活动）：文字与选项经过该包编辑检查、没有独立第二人复核，review 物件如实保留；来源见 apps/server/server/one-more-tune-history-sources.json。
reviewNotes.en: Clues are rewritten from officially signed written transcripts; same-event distractors are excluded by paragraph. The 2020 keynote had no verifiable signed text and is not included. Only what a keynote introduced or demonstrated is checked, never that a feature shipped. The earlier research package's audio questions remain off. On 2026-09-23 the 15 presenter questions prepared by one_more_tune_improvement_20260922 (five events, 2016-2019) were merged: they passed that package's editorial check and no independent second review, which their review objects still say, and their sources are recorded in apps/server/server/one-more-tune-history-sources.json.
